newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah firmer on tighter supply.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah firmer on tighter supply.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was firmer against the dollar in slow late trading on Tuesday on the back of tighter liquidity, dealers said.

They said overall trading remained slow, with most players seen staying on the sidelines. One European bank dealer said the rupiah strengthened slightly after overnight money rose to 16 percent from 10.0/11.0 percent before settling at 13.0 percent.
"There is no major news to drive the market after (last month's general) elections. There was also no initiative from foreign players who often move the market," the dealer said.
Spot rupiah was at 2,428.30/28.75 at 0900 GMT against an opening of 2,429.0/29.5. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,427.8/28.5 and 2,428.50/28.75, respectively.
Dealers said trading was trapped in a narrow range between 2,428.0 and 2,430.0 throughout the day.

They said focus was on Friday liquidity which was anticipated to be tight due to weekly tax payments. They said forward rates were little changed while short-term rates were firming on tightening in the overnight market.
Overnight swap was at 0.35/0.45 and tom/next at 0.3/0.4
